newsitem.title: POLAND: Allianz-BGZ life firm gets Polish licence.
newsitem.headline: Allianz-BGZ life firm gets Polish licence.

text.p: Polish life insurance firm Towarzystwo Ubezpieczeniowe Allianz BGZ Polska Zycie SA received on Friday a finance ministry operating licence, BGZ said in a statement on Monday.
The company, 51-percent controlled by Poland's Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej SA and 49-percent controlled by Germany's Allianz AG Holding, has 14 million zlotys in capital.
An Allianz BGZ Zycie SA representative said last week that the firm could start operating in the second half of 1997, offering insurance for a full range of risks, both group and individual.
Non-life insurance firm Allianz BGZ Polska SA was granted a finance ministry licence late last year.
